title: RAG in Spring: ETL to Advisor
objective: After this lesson you will be able to run ETL ingestion into pgvector, wire QuestionAnswerAdvisor after memory, enforce metadata discipline (sku/version/date), and scope retrieval with filters.
why: RAG theory (RAG Agents course) meets Spring machinery here: document ETL pipelines, vector-store abstractions with pgvector behind them, and the QuestionAnswerAdvisor slotting into tested chains. Enterprise RAG adds two disciplines the theory course assumed: metadata as schema (filterable, versioned, dated) and store choice with migration awareness.

blocks.text: Ingestion is a pipeline: **readers** (PDF/text/JSON per source), **transformers** (splitters with overlap + metadata enrichment: sku/version/date), **writers** (vector store batch inserts). Spring AI models each stage explicitly — transformers compose (character split → metadata attach → filter), writers batch (throughput without timeouts). Untested ETL corrupts silently; probe each stage's output shape before wiring the next.

blocks.caption: Stage contracts with shape probes — ETL you can trust

blocks.text: VectorStore abstraction unifies pgvector/Chroma/MongoDB behind identical calls; **pgvector** is the production default here (Postgres you already operate, transactional guarantees, no new infrastructure). Initialize schema (extension + tables/indexes), choose index type per scale (IVFFlat/HNSW trade recall/latency/build-cost), and keep embeddings provider-pinned (mixed encoders corrupt silently — Ch.3 RAG lesson, enforced in config).

`QuestionAnswerAdvisor` slots **after memory** (Ch.3 ordering) with top-k + similarity thresholds + metadata filters (category/price-band/version). Filters prune before ranking (cheap, exact); thresholds cut the tail (unknowns abstain instead of answering from weak matches). Unfiltered unthresholded retrieval answers confidently from irrelevance — the failure mode filters exist to delete.

blocks.title: Filter then rank
blocks.note: Run it: expect a,b,c then a,c (version filter drops stale b) then empty-correct (no hats exist — abstain, don't hallucinate). Filters prune exactly; thresholds would cut weak scores next.

items: ETL stages with shape probes; transformers compose; writers batch with count verification
pgvector default (operated Postgres, transactional); index per scale; encoders pinned
Advisor after memory; metadata filters prune, thresholds cut tails, abstention beats weak answers

exercise.prompt: (a) Run the practice retrieval on all three filter sets and map outcomes. (b) Add a similarity threshold (score ≥2 to keep) and state which result changes. (c) Write the metadata schema for catalog chunks (5+ keys with staleness roles) defending each key.
hints: Outcomes: unfiltered trio; version-3 pair (stale b dropped); empty hats (abstain-correct).
Threshold ≥2 keeps exact matches only: 'Sandal' (score 1) drops from query 1 — precision over recall, abstention risk noted.
Schema: sku (cite/filter), category (filter), price (money gate), version (staleness), updated (recency) — each key serving filters, citations, or freshness.
exercise.why: Filter-then-threshold mechanics (exact pruning, score cutting) plus metadata-as-schema (every key serving a downstream need) are the two RAG-operational judgments.
exercise.code: // Filter-threshold pattern: exact prune first, score cut second, abstain last.

quiz.q: Stale v2 price quoted confidently. Missing layers?
options: Version metadata + filter (current only) + freshness guard: staleness is a metadata failure, fixed in schema not prompts
quiz.explain: Version/date metadata with filters and guards prevents stale answers structurally. Prompt pleading can't fix missing metadata.

quiz.q: Empty retrieval returns best-effort guesses. Fix?
options: Abstention path: empty results abstain with gap noted — guesses from absence are hallucinations with extra steps
quiz.explain: Empty-correct beats invented: abstention with gap analysis preserves trust and diagnoses corpus holes.

quiz.q: Mixed embedding providers across index and query. Consequence?
options: Confident nonsense: unshared geometry scores noise — pin encoders, verify match, never mix
quiz.explain: Encoder compatibility is load-bearing (RAG Ch.3): mismatched spaces produce decimals without meaning. Pinned and verified.

summary: ETL with probes, pgvector by default, advisor after memory, metadata filters + thresholds + abstention. Enterprise RAG is metadata discipline plus ordering.
